extraction.Name: Joseph St. John
extraction.Refused/Protested: I had never made any application for a Patent and that I didn't want to take it, that if I did I would be required to pay taxes on the land. The Superintendent told me that I would have to pay taxes on the land and that I take the patent and that I was cut loose from the supervision of the Government and was a citizen of the United States.
extraction.NOTES: Mental condition is good, physical condition is fair, financial condition is poor. Edward Little Eagle informed allottee he was wanted at the Agency Office. State of South Dakota, County of Buffalo.
